params.q: What is the normal fasting blood sugar level for adults in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the normal fasting blood sugar level for adults in India?

response.markdown:
**The normal fasting blood sugar level for healthy adults in India is 70–99 mg/dL (3.9–5.5 mmol/L)**, measured after an overnight fast of at least 8 hours. [0] Readings of 100–125 mg/dL indicate prediabetes, and 126 mg/dL or higher on two separate occasions confirms diabetes. [1] [2] [3]

### References

0. [Blood Sugar Chart: Normal, Fasting & Post-Meal Levels (mg/dL & mmol/L)](https://www.medindia.net/patients/calculators/bloodsugar_chart.asp)
1. [Normal Sugar Level: Blood Sugar Range by Age & Test - AHI](https://asianheartinstitute.org/blog/blood-sugar-level-chart-by-age/)
2. [Diabetes Level Chart: Normal, Prediabetes & Diabetes](https://www.medanta.org/patient-education-blog/diabetes-level-chart-normal-prediabetes-diabetes)
3. [Normal Blood Sugar Levels Chart by Age: Fasting & Post-Meal Range ...](https://clearmedi.in/blog/normal-blood-sugar-levels-chart-by-age)
